最近一次用量不是实时上下文占用；缓存输入和推理输出分别属于输入、输出的子集。重新: Latest usage is separate from live context occupancy. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets of input and output. After reconnecting, native notifications are authoritative.
本次连接尚未收到原生回合统计；历史不会被重新计为零。: This connection has not received native turn statistics. Historical usage is not reset to zero.
主循环统计不含子 Agent 和辅助调用；模型累计取最新原生结果，不逐轮相加。原: Main-loop statistics exclude subagents and auxiliary calls. Model totals use the latest native result rather than summing turns. Native reports have their own restore/reset boundaries; they are not subscription quota or billing.
